purpose: Scope manifest for the frozen 2026-11-09 closure snapshot. Gates verify only the studies named in the closure ledger, so adding studies to catalog/entities.json does not invalidate them.
scope_entities_algorithm: sha256 of json.dumps(subset, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')) where subset = {studies, versions (study_id in scope), reviews (any study_id in scope), assessments (study_id in scope), current_assessments} each restricted to scope ids and sorted by id (current_assessments by study_id, project_id)
note: historical_entities_file_sha256 is the whole-file hash at basis_commit, kept as a historical record only; it is no longer compared with the live file.
